‼️TRAFFIC ADVISORY‼️
14 JANUARY 2026

URGENT: FULL ROAD CLOSURE ON N12 WEST DUE TO SHOOTING INCIDENT 

Motorists are advised of a serious security incident on the N12 Westbound before the Diepkloof Interchange. https://t.co/i8BSk01T42

𝐓𝐫𝐚𝐟𝐟𝐢𝐜 𝐀𝐝𝐯𝐢𝐬𝐨𝐫𝐲

𝐓𝐫𝐚𝐟𝐟𝐢𝐜 𝐃𝐢𝐯𝐞𝐫𝐬𝐢𝐨𝐧𝐬 𝐢𝐧 𝐂𝐨𝐧𝐧𝐞𝐜𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧 𝐰𝐢𝐭𝐡 𝐂𝐨𝐧𝐬𝐭𝐫𝐮𝐜𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧 𝐨𝐟 𝐓𝐡𝐞 𝐂𝐨𝐦𝐩𝐫𝐞𝐡𝐞𝐧𝐬𝐢𝐯𝐞 𝐃𝐞𝐯𝐞𝐥𝐨𝐩𝐦𝐞𝐧𝐭 𝐨𝐟 𝐄𝐥𝐞𝐯𝐚𝐭𝐞𝐝 𝐂𝐨𝐫𝐫𝐢𝐝𝐨𝐫 𝐖𝐨𝐫𝐤 𝐟𝐫𝐨𝐦 𝐌𝐚𝐥𝐚𝐤𝐩𝐞𝐭 𝐅𝐢𝐫𝐞 𝐒𝐭𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧 𝐭𝐨 𝐘𝐚𝐝𝐚𝐠𝐢𝐫𝐢 𝐓𝐡𝐞𝐚𝐭𝐞𝐫.

In connection with the construction of the Comprehensive development elevated Corridor work from Malakpet Fire Station to Yadagiri Theater, the following traffic diversions, alternative routes, will be implemented w.e.f. 15-01-2026 for a period of approximately Sixty (60) days.  

Road Closure:

The road stretch between Saidabad Y Junction to I.S. Sadan Junction, in one side from Saidabad Y Junction to Dobhighat, will be closed for the duration of the construction of the Comprehensive development of Elevated Corridor.

General public is advised to avoid the road stretch from Nalgonda X Road to Owaisi Hospital (DMRL Junction), as traffic congestion is expected on surrounding roads and Junctions.

Diversion Points / Alternative Routes for General Public:

1)Traffic coming from Nalgonda X Road towards Saidabad Y Junction intending to proceed to Santosh Nagar & I.S. Sadan will be diverted via  Saidabad Y Junction take left turn via  DCP South East Zone office, via Saidabad  Law & Order PS – Saraswathi Nagar Kaman- Sankeswar Bazar – Indian Petrol Bunk take right turn – Singareni Colony – Onus Robotic Hospital Champapet left turn – Champapet main road take U turn via Champapet X Road – IS Sadan (Only four wheelers (RTC buses also)& Heavy  Goods vehicles. 

2)The Two and Three-wheeler Traffic coming from Chanchalguda towards Saidabad Y Junction intending to go towards I.S. Sadan will be diverted at Saidabad Y junction towards Saidabad L&O PS, 105 Bus Stop take right turn –Ramalayam Kaman–Laxmi Nagar right turn – Biscuit factory – Dobhighat Junction left turn I.S. Sadan Main Road.

3)The Two and Three-wheeler Traffic coming from Chanchalguda towards Saidabad Y Junction intending to go towards Champapet will be diverted via Saidabad Y Junction via Saidabad Law & Order PS – 105 Bus Stop take right turn – Ramalayam Kaman–Laxmi Nagar right turn –Vinay Nagar left turn – Bharath Garden towards I.S. Sadan & Champapet Main road.

4)RTC Buses which are coming from Chaderghat towards I.S. Sadan and Champapet will be diverted at Nalgonda X Road via Malakpet Gunj- Moosarambagh X Road -Gaddiannaram U-Turn – Gaddiannaram X Road take left–Shiva Ganga theatre- Hanifiya Mosque (Saroornagar Lake) take right turn – Indian Oil Petrol Bunk- Left turn-Singareni Colony – Onus Hospital – Champapet Main Road.

5)All the Districts RTC buses and heavy vehicles coming and from MGBS, Chaderghat towards I.S. Sadan and Champapet will be diverted at Nalgonda X Road towards Malakpet Gunj, Moosarambagh, Dilsukh Nagar, Kothapet and LB Nagar Chowrasta.

Commuters are appealed to follow traffic updates on our social media platform @ Hyderabad Traffic Police face book page (https://t.co/RMgFu4sqLB) and @ HYDTP (Twitter handle). In case of any emergency in travel, kindly call our traffic help line 9010203626 for travel assistance.

All citizens are requested to make note of the above diversions and take alternate routes to reach your destinations and cooperate with the Hyderabad Traffic Police.

PEANUT MADE CRYPTO PAYMENTS FEEL LIKE VENMO (HERE'S HOW) 🥜⚡

I just read a case study that made me realize something:

The biggest barrier to crypto adoption isn't tech. It's friction.

@joinpeanut wanted to build global payments. But traditional crypto wallets were killing growth.

So they partnered with @zerodev_app and made the blockchain... invisible.

First, the problem Peanut was solving:

They're building a payment platform for emerging markets and freelancers worldwide.

But asking someone in the Philippines or Nigeria to:
❌ Download MetaMask
❌ Write down seed phrases
❌ Buy ETH for gas
❌ Understand transaction fees

That's a non-starter. Most people bounce before even trying.

Here's what Peanut did instead, using ZeroDev:

⚡Login with FaceID/TouchID (no seed phrases)
⚡Fees happen in the background (users never see them)
⚡ Smooth flow from link → wallet (one click, done)

Suddenly, crypto payments feel like... just payments.
No blockchain PhD required.

Let me break down why each piece matters:

FaceID/TouchID login = you're using biometrics you already trust.
No "write this down and never lose it or your money is gone forever" anxiety.

Just: unlock your phone, access your wallet.

That's the UX people expect in 2026. ZeroDev made it possible.

Fees in the background is the genius move.

In traditional crypto:
"You need 0.0023 ETH for gas"
"What's gas?"
"It's... complicated"
User leaves
With ZeroDev's paymaster infrastructure:
Fees are abstracted. Sponsored. Handled.
The user just sees: "Payment sent." Done.
That's what mass adoption looks like.

Smooth link-to-wallet flow sounds simple, but it's not.

You click a Peanut payment link.
Wallet creates automatically (if you don't have one).
Funds arrive.
You can spend, send, or cash out.
No app downloads. No KYC upfront. No wallet setup tutorial.

Just... it works. Like Venmo. But global and permissionless.

Here's what Konrad Urban (Peanut's cofounder) said about choosing ZeroDev:

"ZeroDev was the clear choice... infrastructure mature enough to be trusted at scale."
That word — mature — is key.
ZeroDev powers 5M+ accounts. This isn't an experiment. It's battle-tested infrastructure that companies can actually build on.

Think about what Peanut didn't have to build:

❌ Account abstraction infrastructure
❌ Paymaster systems for gas sponsorship
❌ Biometric authentication flows
❌ Cross-chain wallet management

ZeroDev handled all of it.
Peanut went straight to building their product instead of reinventing the wheel.

That's months saved. Maybe years.

I tried the https://t.co/Y9uJV2pxF4 demo and honestly... it's kind of magical.

One click. Wallet created. Payment claimed.
No MetaMask popup. No gas estimation screen. No "transaction pending" anxiety.

Just: "You received $10. What do you want to do with it?"
That's what crypto should feel like.

The use case is huge too.

Freelancers getting paid across borders.
Remittances to emerging markets.
Micro-payments for gig work.
All the places where traditional banking is slow, expensive, or inaccessible.
Peanut + ZeroDev just made crypto payments actually viable for those scenarios.

What I love about this:

ZeroDev isn't trying to be the consumer app. They're the infrastructure that makes great consumer apps possible.
Like AWS for Web2.
You don't think about AWS when you use Netflix. You just... watch.

Same here. Users don't think about ZeroDev. They just send money. Seamlessly.

The "invisible blockchain" thesis is real.

For crypto to hit mass adoption, people can't feel the blockchain.
No gas fees. No seed phrases. No network congestion anxiety.
Just: fast, cheap, global payments that work like magic.

@joinpeanut + @zerodev_app proved it's possible. At scale. 🥜

If you're building a Web3 app:
👉 Read the full case study: https://t.co/aEqgLrtXYI

👉 Try the Peanut demo: https://t.co/NNE7yVLUl4
This is what good infrastructure unlocks. Don't rebuild what already works. Build what's new.
